mapper.select: SELECT code, name, normalized_name, region, aliases::text AS aliases, latitude, longitude, dataset_version, is_active, created_at FROM provinces WHERE is_active = TRUE AND dataset_version = #{datasetVersion} ORDER BY code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM provinces WHERE is_active = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_places, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE province_code IS NOT NULL) AS assigned_places, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE province_status = 'AMBIGUOUS') AS ambiguous_places, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL) AS places_with_coordinates, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE province_code IS NOT NULL AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL) AS assigned_places_with_coordinates FROM places

SELECT id, title, address, latitude, longitude, province_code, province_confidence FROM places WHERE province_status = 'AMBIGUOUS' ORDER BY province_confidence DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET province_code = #{provinceCode}, province_status = #{status}, province_confidence = #{confidence}, province_assigned_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{placeId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, address, latitude, longitude FROM places WHERE province_code IS NULL AND (province_status IS NULL OR province_status = 'PENDING') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passport_events (id, user_id, source, source_id, place_id, checkin_id, location_key, location_name, latitude, longitude, province_code, occurred_at, is_verified, is_hidden, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{source}, #{sourceId}, #{placeId}, #{checkinId}, #{locationKey}, #{locationName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{provinceCode}, #{occurredAt}, #{isVerified}, #{isHidden}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (source, source_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE passport_events SET is_hidden = #{hidden} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS checkin_id, c.user_id, c.checked_in_at, c.lat, c.lng, a.name AS location_name, p.id AS place_id, p.province_code AS province_code FROM checkins c JOIN activities a ON a.id = c.activity_id -- activities.place_id holds the external identifier, places.id is the internal -- one; the passport event references the internal row. LEFT JOIN places p ON p.place_id = a.place_id WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_events e WHERE e.source = 'ACTIVITY_CHECKIN' AND e.source_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.checked_in_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS event_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_verified) AS verified_event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(location_key, place_id::text)) AS distinct_place_count, COUNT(DISTINCT province_code) FILTER (WHERE province_code IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_province_count, MIN(occurred_at) AS first_event_at, MAX(occurred_at) AS last_event_at FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT province_code FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND province_code IS NOT NULL
SELECT province_code AS code, COUNT(*) AS total FROM passport_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND province_code IS NOT NULL AND is_hidden = FALSE GROUP BY province_code
SELECT * FROM passport_stamp_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY threshold, code
SELECT * FROM passport_stamp_rules WHERE code = #{code} AND version = #{version}
SELECT * FROM passport_stamp_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY threshold, code, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passport_stamp_rules (code, version, name, description, condition_type, threshold, icon, reward_points, is_active, created_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{version}, #{name}, #{description}, #{conditionType}, #{threshold}, #{icon}, #{rewardPoints}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO passport_stamps (id, user_id, rule_code, rule_version, triggering_event_id, awarded_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{ruleCode}, #{ruleVersion}, #{triggeringEventId}, #{awardedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, rule_code, rule_version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM passport_stamps WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY awarded_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO passport_province_wishes (user_id, province_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provinceCode}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, province_code) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM passport_province_wishes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND province_code = #{provinceCode}
mapper.select: SELECT province_code FROM passport_province_wishes WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT province_code FROM places WHERE id = #{placeId}

SELECT DISTINCT t.* FROM passport_tags t JOIN passport_definitions d ON d.id = t.passport_id AND d.is_active = TRUE WHERE t.is_active = TRUE AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_tag_places linked WHERE linked.passport_tag_id = t.id AND linked.place_id = #{placeId} ) OR ( t.qualification_mode = 'PASSPORT_PROVINCES' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_tag_places linked WHERE linked.passport_tag_id = t.id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_definition_provinces dp WHERE dp.passport_id = d.id AND dp.province_code = #{provinceCode} ) ) OR ( t.qualification_mode = 'PASSPORT_LOCATIONS' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_tag_places linked WHERE linked.passport_tag_id = t.id ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_definition_location_images pdi JOIN location_images li ON li.id = pdi.location_image_id LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id = #{placeId} WHERE pdi.passport_id = d.id AND ( (p.id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.latitude, CAST(#{latitude} AS NUMERIC)) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.longitude, CAST(#{longitude} AS NUMERIC)) IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * acos(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, cos(radians(li.latitude)) * cos(radians(COALESCE(p.latitude, CAST(#{latitude} AS NUMERIC)))) * cos(radians(COALESCE(p.longitude, CAST(#{longitude} AS NUMERIC))) - radians(li.longitude)) + sin(radians(li.latitude)) * sin(radians(COALESCE(p.latitude, CAST(#{latitude} AS NUMERIC)))) ))) <= #{locationRadiusKm}) OR (p.id IS NULL AND CAST(#{latitude} AS NUMERIC) IS NOT NULL AND CAST(#{longitude} AS NUMERIC) IS NOT NULL AND li.latitude IS NOT NULL AND li.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * acos(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, cos(radians(li.latitude)) * cos(radians(CAST(#{latitude} AS NUMERIC))) * cos(radians(CAST(#{longitude} AS NUMERIC)) - radians(li.longitude)) + sin(radians(li.latitude)) * sin(radians(CAST(#{latitude} AS NUMERIC))) ))) <= #{locationRadiusKm}) ) ) ) ) ORDER BY t.display_order, t.name

SELECT DISTINCT t.*, d.code AS passport_code, d.name AS passport_name, upt.awarded_at, upt.triggering_event_id FROM passport_tags t JOIN passport_definitions d ON d.id = t.passport_id AND d.is_active = TRUE LEFT JOIN passport_tag_places linked ON linked.passport_tag_id = t.id AND linked.place_id = #{placeId} LEFT JOIN places place ON place.id = #{placeId} LEFT JOIN passport_definition_provinces dp ON dp.passport_id = d.id AND dp.province_code = place.province_code LEFT JOIN user_passport_tags upt ON upt.passport_tag_id = t.id AND upt.user_id = #{userId} WHERE t.is_active = TRUE AND ( linked.place_id IS NOT NULL OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_tag_places any_link WHERE any_link.passport_tag_id = t.id ) AND ( (t.qualification_mode = 'PASSPORT_PROVINCES' AND dp.passport_id IS NOT NULL) OR ( t.qualification_mode = 'PASSPORT_LOCATIONS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_definition_location_images pdi JOIN location_images li ON li.id = pdi.location_image_id WHERE pdi.passport_id = d.id AND place.latitude IS NOT NULL AND place.longitude IS NOT NULL AND li.latitude IS NOT NULL AND li.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * acos(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, cos(radians(li.latitude)) * cos(radians(place.latitude)) * cos(radians(place.longitude) - radians(li.longitude)) + sin(radians(li.latitude)) * sin(radians(place.latitude)) ))) <= #{locationRadiusKm} ) ) ) ) ) ORDER BY t.display_order, t.name

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(e.place_id::text, NULLIF(e.location_key, ''))) FROM passport_events e LEFT JOIN places p ON p.id = e.place_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM passport_definition_location_images pdi JOIN location_images li ON li.id = pdi.location_image_id WHERE pdi.passport_id = #{tag.passportId} AND li.latitude IS NOT NULL AND li.longitude IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.latitude, e.latitude) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.longitude, e.longitude) IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * acos(LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, cos(radians(li.latitude)) * cos(radians(COALESCE(p.latitude, e.latitude))) * cos(radians(COALESCE(p.longitude, e.longitude)) - radians(li.longitude)) + sin(radians(li.latitude)) * sin(radians(COALESCE(p.latitude, e.latitude))) ))) <= #{locationRadiusKm} )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_passport_tags (user_id, passport_tag_id, triggering_event_id, awarded_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{passportTagId}, #{triggeringEventId}, #{awardedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, passport_tag_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, d.code AS passport_code, d.name AS passport_name, upt.awarded_at, upt.triggering_event_id FROM user_passport_tags upt JOIN passport_tags t ON t.id = upt.passport_tag_id JOIN passport_definitions d ON d.id = t.passport_id WHERE upt.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY upt.awarded_at DESC
